title: Cloud Engineer Learning Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to move from zero experience to a job‑ready cloud engineer. You’ll master core concepts, build real projects, and prepare for certifications.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build a solid base in cloud concepts, networking, and security fundamentals.

milestones.title: Understand Cloud Computing Basics
milestones.outcome: Explain core cloud models and services to non‑technical stakeholders.

tasks.title: Read Cloud Service Models Overview
tasks.description: Study the IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS sections on the AWS and Azure documentation.

tasks.title: Watch Intro to Cloud Video
tasks.description: Complete the freeCodeCamp "Introduction to Cloud Computing" video series (first two modules).

tasks.title: Summarize Key Concepts
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary comparing AWS, Azure, and GCP offerings.

tasks.title: Create a Glossary Sheet
tasks.description: List 20 common cloud terms with definitions using MDN and official docs as references.

milestones.title: Fundamentals of Networking
milestones.outcome: Design simple network topologies and explain traffic flow in a cloud environment.

tasks.title: Read VPC Basics on AWS Docs
tasks.description: Focus on subnets, route tables, and internet gateways.

tasks.title: Complete FreeCodeCamp Networking Module
tasks.description: Finish the “Networking Fundamentals” lessons and quizzes.

tasks.title: Draw a Sample VPC Diagram
tasks.description: Sketch a 2‑subnet VPC with a public web tier and private DB tier using pen and paper.

tasks.title: Configure a Test VPC in Free Tier
tasks.description: Use the AWS console to create a VPC, two subnets, and a security group.

tasks.title: Reflect on Security Implications
tasks.description: Write a short note on why subnet isolation matters for security.

milestones.title: IAM and Security Foundations
milestones.outcome: Implement basic identity and access controls in a cloud account.

tasks.title: Read IAM Overview on Azure Docs
tasks.description: Cover users, groups, roles, and RBAC concepts.

tasks.title: Watch IAM Security Best Practices Video
tasks.description: Use the official AWS YouTube playlist (first 15 minutes).

tasks.title: Create IAM Users and Groups
tasks.description: In the free tier console, add two users, assign them to a group with limited permissions.

tasks.title: Write an Access Policy Document
tasks.description: Draft a JSON policy granting read‑only S3 access for a specific bucket.

tasks.title: Discuss Principle of Least Privilege
tasks.description: Post a brief explanation in a community forum (e.g., Reddit r/cloud) and respond to comments.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Gain hands‑on experience with compute, storage, and cost management services.

milestones.title: Deploy Compute Resources
milestones.outcome: Launch and manage virtual machines or containers on a cloud platform.

tasks.title: Follow EC2 Launch Guide
tasks.description: Use the AWS free tier tutorial to start a t2.micro instance with a web server.

tasks.title: Install Docker on the Instance
tasks.description: SSH into the EC2 box and install Docker CE following the official docs.

tasks.title: Run a Sample Container
tasks.description: Pull and run the official nginx container, verify it serves a page.

tasks.title: Document Deployment Steps
tasks.description: Write a markdown file describing each step for future reference.

tasks.title: Share Experience on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Post a short update with screenshots and ask for feedback.

milestones.title: Manage Cloud Storage Services
milestones.outcome: Create, secure, and retrieve data using cloud storage options.

tasks.title: Read S3 Fundamentals on AWS Docs
tasks.description: Focus on buckets, objects, versioning, and lifecycle rules.

tasks.title: Create an S3 Bucket with Versioning
tasks.description: Set up a bucket in the free tier, enable versioning, and upload test files.

tasks.title: Configure Bucket Policy for Public Access
tasks.description: Write a policy that allows read‑only access to a specific folder.

tasks.title: Explore Azure Blob Storage Quickstart
tasks.description: Follow the Microsoft tutorial to upload and download a blob via portal.

tasks.title: Compare Costs of Storage Classes
tasks.description: Use the pricing calculators to note differences between Standard, Infrequent Access, and Glacier.

milestones.title: Cost Management Basics
milestones.outcome: Monitor and optimize cloud spending using native tools.

tasks.title: Watch AWS Cost Explorer Intro Video
tasks.description: View the first 20 minutes of the official AWS Cost Explorer tutorial.

tasks.title: Set Up a Billing Alarm
tasks.description: Create a CloudWatch alarm that notifies when monthly spend exceeds $5.

tasks.title: Generate a Monthly Cost Report
tasks.description: Export the cost and usage report for the last month as CSV.

tasks.title: Identify Savings Opportunities
tasks.description: Analyze the report and list three ways to reduce costs (e.g., right‑size instances).

tasks.title: Discuss Findings with a Peer
tasks.description: Join a free cloud community chat and share your cost‑saving ideas.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that showcase end‑to‑end cloud solutions.

milestones.title: 3‑Tier Web Application
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate ability to design, deploy, and secure a multi‑tier app on a cloud provider.

tasks.title: Plan Architecture Diagram
tasks.description: Sketch a diagram with a public load balancer, web servers, and private database tier.

tasks.title: Deploy VPC and Subnets
tasks.description: Use Terraform (free) to provision the network layout in AWS.

tasks.title: Launch EC2 Web Tier
tasks.description: Create an autoscaling group with a simple Node.js app behind an ALB.

tasks.title: Set Up RDS Instance
tasks.description: Provision a free‑tier PostgreSQL database in a private subnet.

tasks.title: Document Project on GitHub
tasks.description: Write a README, include architecture diagram, and add deployment instructions.

milestones.title: Cost‑Optimised Architecture Write‑up
milestones.outcome: Showcase analytical skills in reducing cloud spend while maintaining performance.

tasks.title: Select a Sample Workload
tasks.description: Choose a common scenario such as a data‑processing pipeline.

tasks.title: Analyze Current Cost Profile
tasks.description: Use the pricing calculator to estimate baseline expenses.

tasks.title: Propose Optimization Strategies
tasks.description: Write three concrete changes (e.g., reserved instances, storage class shift).

tasks.title: Create a Cost‑Benefit Table
tasks.description: Tabulate projected savings versus implementation effort.

tasks.title: Publish Write‑up on Medium
tasks.description: Post the article, include diagrams, and invite comments.

milestones.title: Associate‑Level Certification Prep
milestones.outcome: Pass an entry‑level cloud certification exam (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Associate).

tasks.title: Review Exam Guide
tasks.description: Read the official AWS Solutions Architect Associate exam guide PDF.

tasks.title: Complete FreeCodeCamp Cloud Cert Course
tasks.description: Finish the relevant modules and quizzes covering exam topics.

tasks.title: Take Practice Exam
tasks.description: Attempt a free practice test from AWS Training and note weak areas.

tasks.title: Revise Weak Topics
tasks.description: Watch targeted YouTube videos on identified gaps (e.g., VPC peering).

tasks.title: Schedule Real Exam
tasks.description: Book the exam slot and set a study deadline.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, professional presence, and job‑search tactics.

milestones.title: Advanced Security and Governance
milestones.outcome: Implement role‑based access, encryption, and compliance checks.

tasks.title: Enable AWS Config Rules
tasks.description: Activate three managed rules to monitor security best practices.

tasks.title: Set Up KMS Encryption
tasks.description: Create a customer‑managed key and encrypt an S3 bucket with it.

tasks.title: Apply Azure Policy Initiative
tasks.description: Assign a built‑in policy that enforces tag compliance on resources.

tasks.title: Write a Security Checklist
tasks.description: Draft a concise checklist for future deployments.

tasks.title: Discuss Checklist in Forum
tasks.description: Share the checklist on a cloud security forum and gather feedback.

milestones.title: Performance and Automation
milestones.outcome: Automate infrastructure provisioning and monitor performance metrics.

tasks.title: Write Terraform Module for VPC
tasks.description: Create a reusable module that defines subnets, route tables, and IGW.

tasks.title: Configure CloudWatch Dashboards
tasks.description: Set up widgets to monitor CPU, network, and latency for the web tier.

tasks.title: Implement CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Use GitHub Actions (free) to deploy the 3‑tier app on push.

tasks.title: Benchmark Application Latency
tasks.description: Run a load test with k6 and record response times.

tasks.title: Reflect on Automation Benefits
tasks.description: Write a brief note on time saved and error reduction.

milestones.title: Job‑Search and Professional Branding
milestones.outcome: Present yourself as a qualified cloud engineer and secure interviews.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn Profile
tasks.description: Add new skills, certifications, and link to GitHub projects.

tasks.title: Craft a Targeted Resume
tasks.description: Tailor the resume for cloud engineer roles, highlighting projects and cost‑saving write‑up.

tasks.title: Practice System Design Interview
tasks.description: Do a mock interview with a peer focusing on designing a scalable service.

tasks.title: Apply to 5 Jobs
tasks.description: Submit applications to positions that require the associate‑level certification you earned.

tasks.title: Seek Feedback on Portfolio
tasks.description: Ask a mentor or community member to review your GitHub repos and give improvement tips.
